manifest.method: For each tokenizer and complete pair, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)). Average equally within each six-item focus-site stratum and equally across the four strata. The headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means. Mint before importing tiktoken and file every finite outcome once without tuning.

only the safety observer cleared the platform.
only two senior curators handled the tapestry.
only our western coordinator issued the gale notice.
only the contract reviewer released the appendix.
only Ephraim marked the protected grove.
I only annotated the errata sheet.
we only quarantined the second culture.

test_set.english: the auditor only crosschecked the travel ledger.

test_set.english: the timer only rearmed the eastern sensor.

comparison_identity.comparator: hyphen-welded only-<focus> versus bare only at the identical focus site
comparison_identity.population: 24 fresh complete sentences balanced six each across subject, verb, object-nominal and adjunct focus
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal item mean per stratum, equal stratum mean per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean

manifest.evidentiary_limit: This measures current tokenizer cost of the focus weld against bare only. It does not establish focus comprehension, prosodic recovery, future Ainglish-aware tokenizer cost, or adoption.
